mapper.select: SELECT c.cart_no, c.memberId, c.product_code, c.quantity, c.created_date, p.product_name, p.product_en_name, p.thumbnail, p.label_type, p.label_country, p.label_grapevariety, p.price_discount, p.price_original, p.price_deal, p.price_deal_price, p.price_deal_amount FROM cart c JOIN product p ON c.product_code = p.product_code WHERE c.memberId = #{memberId} ORDER BY c.cart_no DESC
